label: Two-factor authentication
means: Whether the signed-in account has two-factor authentication on.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Configuring two-factor authentication (https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/securing-your-account-with-two-factor-authentication-2fa/configuring-two-factor-authentication, read 2026-11-26)
source: state: gh api user: two_factor_authentication, which GitHub returns to the account itself only

params.comment: owner: the GitHub user read; empty means the signed-in user. Private settings answer only the signed-in user.

label: Commit signing keys
means: GPG keys and SSH signing keys on the account, so its commits can show Verified.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, About commit signature verification (https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/managing-commit-signature-verification/about-commit-signature-verification, read 2026-11-26); template goal: at least one key
source: state: gh api users/<login>/gpg_keys and users/<login>/ssh_signing_keys, public lists that need no scope

label: One read
means: Seconds this tab's collector takes to read the account's security settings.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Best practices for using the REST API (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/best-practices-for-using-the-rest-api, read 2026-11-26), asks for serial requests; template goal: a few serial reads finish in seconds
source: wall time of this tab's collector, first request to last

label: API requests per read
means: gh api requests one read of the account's security settings spends.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Rate limits for the REST API (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api, read 2026-11-26): GITHUB_TOKEN gets 1,000 requests per hour per repository; template goal: one read spends a hundredth of that
source: gh api requests this tab's collector made, one per page
